Nick Bosa, Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel all missed practice again Thursday, though Christian Kirk was full and could make his 49ers debut. The Falcons are 2-4 after a third straight home loss; AJ Terrell is limited as his IR window opens, while Deablo, Bowman and RB Brian Robinson sat.

items.text: QB Baker Mayfield (thumb, missed three games) full Wed and Thu; decision Friday. Rookie Jalon Daniels starts if he can't.
WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) and T Luke Goedeke (calf) DNP again; RB Bucky Irving up to limited.
OLBs Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Thomas Incoom (calf) DNP both days; CBs Horn and Mike Jackson on IR.
RT Taylor Moton full Thursday and could be activated soon.

nfl_2026_07_TB_CAR.summary: The 1-5 Buccaneers visit NFC South leader Carolina. Baker Mayfield (thumb) practiced fully again Thursday; Tampa Bay hopes for clarity Friday, with rookie Jalon Daniels starting if he can't go. Egbuka and Goedeke sat again, Bucky Irving was limited. Carolina's edge rushers Jaelan Phillips and Thomas Incoom missed both days.
